proves.claim: replayTuned replays with replayFlow and, at each landing time the cycle clock says is due, builds the last two four-hour windows, applies the one chooseTuning change to the policy from then on, and reverts it at the next due cycle when revertTuning says revert.

stats.logic-flow-replay.tuned-applies-cy.why: Without it the replay cannot show what the line tuner would have done to a recorded history.

proves.claim: replayTuned returns tuned, untuned and changes; untuned equals replayFlow for the same events and policy, both carry each stage median, and the same input gives the same result twice.

stats.logic-flow-replay.tuned-side-by-si.why: Without it a tuned replay could not be compared with the untuned one, or checked to be repeatable.
